description.value:
Some say the HSS-19 is just a fashionable marketing tool, since it was made for and heavily showcased in Zeig Dich, a BDSM themed spy thriller BD that premiered in 2076. Those who’ve actually shot one say it’s a damn good pistol with sound suppression, gyroscopic stabilization, and quickdraw aim assist. As is typical in many debates, both of these statements are correct. The HSS-19 won’t shatter metal or fire through walls, but it’s shiny, silent, and effective.

Cost: 3,200eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Improved Silencer, Parallax, Pistol Long Barrel, Zenith • Mods: Fashionista (w/ Superchrome® Covering)

Special Features: Provides a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style while worn openly, which does not stack with any other Superchrome-based bonus [Fashionista]. This weapon imposes a -2 penalty to Perception Checks made to hear it firing [Improved Silencer]. When making an Aimed Shot with this weapon, the user may instead use the Carbine Range Table [Parallax]. The first Turn in combat this weapon makes a Single Shot Attack, the user gains a +1 bonus to their Attack Check [Zenith].

Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Improved Silencer, Parallax, Pistol Long Barrel, Zenith (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Fashionista (w/ Superchrome® Covering)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
